What is in, what was removed for good and why, and what has been proposed but
not built. IN is `registry.ts`; OUT and BACKLOG are `ledger.json`; this page is
rendered from both and the gate refuses a hand edit. The same three lists are the
gallery's Ledger page. Picks per game come from `art/games/*.json`; a bold game is
the one whose default binding is that style.

## Backlog (33) - researched, not built

Proposed from the 2026-09-05 research pass (pixel sub-styles, teen and adult 2D
styles, print and craft). None has a renderer. A row marked `adjacent-to-rejected`
sits next to a style the operator removed and needs an explicit yes before anyone
builds it. Audience is who the style suits, not who it is limited to.

## How it moves

- **Backlog to IN**: build `art/styles/<id>/{render.ts,recipe.md}`, add the registry
  row, delete the backlog row, `--write`. The recipe gate and render-smoke take it
  from there.
- **IN to OUT**: delete the directory and the row, add an OUT row with the commit
  and the operator's words, record `rejected mood` in the taste ledger, `--write`.
  `--sync` does the first two from git, taste and the notes store on this machine.
- **OUT to IN**: not a restore. It is a new decision, recorded as such.
